confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel rates are less certain and vary by season, events and platform. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 5.5x beer, wine glass about 4x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX was taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as surfaced in search results, not opened directly. A 2026-10-16 figure of 0.6947 appeared only on a third-party site and was not used as the official value.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is other Chinese provincial-capital cities of similar size and tourist profile, such as Hangzhou and Wuhan, adjusted for Nanjing's typical local restaurant, café and hotel price levels.
